-- ========================================================================
-- Script: Actualización de campaign_id en MENSAJES DE RESPUESTA
-- Propósito: Asociar respuestas de clientes con la campaña que les enviamos
-- Fecha: 2026-01-05
-- ========================================================================

-- IMPORTANTE: Este script actualiza la tabla MESSAGES, no conversation_assignments
-- Se enfoca en mensajes entrantes (respuestas) que no tienen campaign_id

-- ========================================================================
-- PASO 1: DIAGNÓSTICO - Ver mensajes de respuesta SIN campaign_id
-- ========================================================================

SELECT
    'Total mensajes incoming' AS tipo,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad
FROM messages
WHERE direction = 'incoming'
  AND deleted_at IS NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'Con campaign_id' AS tipo,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad
FROM messages
WHERE direction = 'incoming'
  AND campaign_id IS NOT NULL
  AND deleted_at IS NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'Sin campaign_id' AS tipo,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad
FROM messages
WHERE direction = 'incoming'
  AND campaign_id IS NULL
  AND deleted_at IS NULL;

-- ========================================================================
-- PASO 2: IDENTIFICAR respuestas que DEBERÍAN tener campaign_id
-- Encuentra mensajes incoming sin campaign_id donde existe un mensaje
-- de campaña previo al mismo número
-- ========================================================================

SELECT
    incoming.id AS message_id,
    incoming.phone_number,
    incoming.line_id,
    incoming.created_at AS response_date,
    incoming.campaign_id AS current_campaign_id,
    campaign_msg.campaign_id AS should_have_campaign_id,
    campaign_msg.campaign_name,
    campaign_msg.sent_at AS campaign_sent_date,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, campaign_msg.sent_at, incoming.created_at) AS minutes_after_campaign
FROM messages incoming
INNER JOIN (
    -- Encuentra el mensaje de campaña MÁS RECIENTE antes de cada respuesta
    SELECT
        m.phone_number,
        m.line_id,
        m.campaign_id,
        m.campaign_name,
        m.created_at AS sent_at,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY m.phone_number, m.line_id
            ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM messages m
    WHERE m.is_mass_campaign = TRUE
      AND m.direction = 'outgoing'
      AND m.campaign_id IS NOT NULL
      AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
) campaign_msg
    ON campaign_msg.phone_number = incoming.phone_number
    AND campaign_msg.line_id = incoming.line_id
    AND campaign_msg.rn = 1
    AND campaign_msg.sent_at < incoming.created_at  -- Campaña enviada ANTES de la respuesta
WHERE incoming.direction = 'incoming'
  AND incoming.campaign_id IS NULL  -- Sin campaign_id actualmente
  AND incoming.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY incoming.created_at DESC
LIMIT 50;

    COUNT(*) AS total_respuestas_a_actualizar
FROM messages incoming
WHERE incoming.direction = 'incoming'
  AND incoming.campaign_id IS NULL
  AND incoming.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM messages campaign_msg
      WHERE campaign_msg.phone_number = incoming.phone_number
        AND campaign_msg.line_id = incoming.line_id
        AND campaign_msg.is_mass_campaign = TRUE
        AND campaign_msg.direction = 'outgoing'
        AND campaign_msg.campaign_id IS NOT NULL
        AND campaign_msg.created_at < incoming.created_at
        AND campaign_msg.deleted_at IS NULL
  );

-- ADVERTENCIA: Esto modificará los datos

SELECT
    incoming.id AS message_id,
    latest_campaign.campaign_id,
    latest_campaign.campaign_name,
    latest_campaign.assigned_user_id,
    latest_campaign.assigned_user_ids
FROM messages incoming
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
        m.phone_number,
        m.line_id,
        m.campaign_id,
        m.campaign_name,
        m.assigned_user_id,
        m.assigned_user_ids,
        m.created_at,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY m.phone_number, m.line_id
            ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM messages m
    WHERE m.is_mass_campaign = TRUE
      AND m.direction = 'outgoing'
      AND m.campaign_id IS NOT NULL
      AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
) latest_campaign
    ON latest_campaign.phone_number = incoming.phone_number
    AND latest_campaign.line_id = incoming.line_id
    AND latest_campaign.rn = 1
    AND latest_campaign.created_at < incoming.created_at
WHERE incoming.direction = 'incoming'
  AND incoming.campaign_id IS NULL
  AND incoming.deleted_at IS NULL;

    COUNT(DISTINCT campaign_id) AS campanas_distintas,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBSTRING_INDEX(campaign_id, '-', 1)) AS tipos_campana
FROM temp_message_campaigns;

-- ACTUALIZAR los mensajes con el campaign_id correcto
UPDATE messages m
INNER JOIN temp_message_campaigns tmp ON tmp.message_id = m.id
SET
    m.campaign_id = tmp.campaign_id,
    m.campaign_name = tmp.campaign_name,
    -- También actualizar assigned_user_ids si están vacíos
    m.assigned_user_id = COALESCE(m.assigned_user_id, tmp.assigned_user_id),
    m.assigned_user_ids = COALESCE(m.assigned_user_ids, tmp.assigned_user_ids);

-- Limpiar tabla temporal

Cuando un receptor responde a un mensaje de campaña, la **respuesta** (registro en tabla `messages` con `direction='incoming'`) no tiene el `campaign_id` asociado.

### Impacto
- Las respuestas no se asocian a la campaña que las originó
- El agente asignado a la campaña no ve las respuestas
- Las métricas de campaña no reflejan las respuestas reales
- El seguimiento de conversiones es incorrecto

---

El archivo `MassCampaignService.js` fue corregido para que:
1. Cree/actualice correctamente el `ConversationAssignment` con el `campaign_id`
2. El `WebhookService` encuentre este assignment cuando llega una respuesta
3. Asigne el `campaign_id` al mensaje de respuesta automáticamente

    campaign_msg.campaign_id AS should_have_campaign_id,
    campaign_msg.campaign_name,
    campaign_msg.sent_at AS campaign_sent_date,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, campaign_msg.sent_at, incoming.created_at) AS minutes_after_campaign
FROM messages incoming
INNER JOIN (
    -- Encuentra el mensaje de campaña MÁS RECIENTE antes de cada respuesta
    SELECT
        m.phone_number,
        m.line_id,
        m.campaign_id,
        m.campaign_name,
        m.created_at AS sent_at,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY m.phone_number, m.line_id
            ORDER BY m.created_at DESC

    FROM messages m
    WHERE m.is_mass_campaign = TRUE
      AND m.direction = 'outgoing'
      AND m.campaign_id IS NOT NULL
      AND m.deleted_at IS NULL

    AND campaign_msg.line_id = incoming.line_id
    AND campaign_msg.rn = 1

  AND incoming.deleted_at IS NULL

-- ========================================================================
-- Script: Actualización de campaign_id en MENSAJES (INCOMING y OUTGOING)
-- Propósito: Asociar todos los mensajes de una conversación con su campaña

-- ========================================================================

-- IMPORTANTE: Este script actualiza la tabla MESSAGES, no conversation_assignments
-- Actualiza:
-- - Mensajes INCOMING (respuestas de clientes)
-- - Mensajes OUTGOING manuales (respuestas de agentes, is_mass_campaign=FALSE)

SELECT
    'INCOMING - Total' AS tipo,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad
FROM messages
WHERE direction = 'incoming'
  AND deleted_at IS NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'INCOMING - Con campaign_id' AS tipo,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad
FROM messages
WHERE direction = 'incoming'
  AND campaign_id IS NOT NULL
  AND deleted_at IS NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'INCOMING - Sin campaign_id' AS tipo,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad
FROM messages
WHERE direction = 'incoming'
  AND campaign_id IS NULL
  AND deleted_at IS NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'OUTGOING manual - Total' AS tipo,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad
FROM messages
WHERE direction = 'outgoing'
  AND is_mass_campaign = FALSE
  AND deleted_at IS NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'OUTGOING manual - Con campaign_id' AS tipo,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad
FROM messages
WHERE direction = 'outgoing'
  AND is_mass_campaign = FALSE
  AND campaign_id IS NOT NULL
  AND deleted_at IS NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'OUTGOING manual - Sin campaign_id' AS tipo,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad
FROM messages
WHERE direction = 'outgoing'
  AND is_mass_campaign = FALSE
  AND campaign_id IS NULL
  AND deleted_at IS NULL;

-- ========================================================================
-- PASO 2: IDENTIFICAR mensajes que DEBERÍAN tener campaign_id
-- Encuentra mensajes (incoming y outgoing manual) sin campaign_id donde
-- existe un mensaje de campaña previo al mismo número
-- ========================================================================

SELECT
    msg.id AS message_id,
    msg.direction,
    msg.phone_number,
    msg.line_id,
    msg.created_at AS message_date,
    msg.campaign_id AS current_campaign_id,
    campaign_msg.campaign_id AS should_have_campaign_id,
    campaign_msg.campaign_name,
    campaign_msg.sent_at AS campaign_sent_date,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, campaign_msg.sent_at, msg.created_at) AS minutes_after_campaign
FROM messages msg
INNER JOIN (
    -- Encuentra el mensaje de campaña MÁS RECIENTE antes de cada mensaje
    SELECT
        m.phone_number,
        m.line_id,
        m.campaign_id,
        m.campaign_name,
        m.created_at AS sent_at,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY m.phone_number, m.line_id
            ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM messages m
    WHERE m.is_mass_campaign = TRUE
      AND m.direction = 'outgoing'
      AND m.campaign_id IS NOT NULL
      AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
) campaign_msg
    ON campaign_msg.phone_number = msg.phone_number
    AND campaign_msg.line_id = msg.line_id
    AND campaign_msg.rn = 1
    AND campaign_msg.sent_at < msg.created_at  -- Campaña enviada ANTES del mensaje
WHERE msg.campaign_id IS NULL  -- Sin campaign_id actualmente
  AND msg.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND (
      -- Mensajes incoming (respuestas de clientes)
      msg.direction = 'incoming'
      OR
      -- Mensajes outgoing manuales (respuestas de agentes)
      (msg.direction = 'outgoing' AND msg.is_mass_campaign = FALSE)
  )
ORDER BY msg.created_at DESC
LIMIT 50;

        AND campaign_msg.is_mass_campaign = TRUE
        AND campaign_msg.direction = 'outgoing'
        AND campaign_msg.campaign_id IS NOT NULL
        AND campaign_msg.created_at < incoming.created_at
        AND campaign_msg.deleted_at IS NULL
  );

SELECT
    incoming.id AS message_id,
    latest_campaign.campaign_id,
    latest_campaign.campaign_name,
    latest_campaign.assigned_user_id,
    latest_campaign.assigned_user_ids
FROM messages incoming
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
        m.phone_number,
        m.line_id,
        m.campaign_id,
        m.campaign_name,
        m.assigned_user_id,
        m.assigned_user_ids,
        m.created_at,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY m.phone_number, m.line_id
            ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM messages m
    WHERE m.is_mass_campaign = TRUE
      AND m.direction = 'outgoing'
      AND m.campaign_id IS NOT NULL
      AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
) latest_campaign
    ON latest_campaign.phone_number = incoming.phone_number
    AND latest_campaign.line_id = incoming.line_id
    AND latest_campaign.rn = 1
    AND latest_campaign.created_at < incoming.created_at
WHERE incoming.direction = 'incoming'
  AND incoming.campaign_id IS NULL
  AND incoming.deleted_at IS NULL;

    COUNT(DISTINCT campaign_id) AS campanas_distintas,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBSTRING_INDEX(campaign_id, '-', 1)) AS tipos_campana
FROM temp_message_campaigns;

-- ACTUALIZAR los mensajes con el campaign_id correcto
UPDATE messages m
INNER JOIN temp_message_campaigns tmp ON tmp.message_id = m.id
SET
    m.campaign_id = tmp.campaign_id,

    latest_campaign.campaign_name,
    latest_campaign.assigned_user_id,
    latest_campaign.assigned_user_ids

        m.line_id,
        m.campaign_id,
        m.campaign_name,
        m.assigned_user_id,
        m.assigned_user_ids,
        m.created_at,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY m.phone_number, m.line_id
            ORDER BY m.created_at DESC

    FROM messages m
    WHERE m.is_mass_campaign = TRUE

      AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
) latest_campaign
    ON latest_campaign.phone_number = incoming.phone_number
    AND latest_campaign.line_id = incoming.line_id
    AND latest_campaign.rn = 1
    AND latest_campaign.created_at < incoming.created_at
WHERE incoming.direction = 'incoming'
  AND incoming.campaign_id IS NULL
  AND incoming.deleted_at IS NULL;

-- ========================================================================
-- Script: Actualización de campaign_id en MENSAJES (INCOMING y OUTGOING)
-- Propósito: Asociar todos los mensajes de una conversación con su campaña
-- Fecha: 2026-01-05
-- ========================================================================

-- IMPORTANTE: Este script actualiza la tabla MESSAGES, no conversation_assignments
-- Actualiza:
-- - Mensajes INCOMING (respuestas de clientes)
-- - Mensajes OUTGOING manuales (respuestas de agentes, is_mass_campaign=FALSE)

-- ========================================================================
-- PASO 1: DIAGNÓSTICO - Ver mensajes SIN campaign_id
-- ========================================================================

SELECT
    'INCOMING - Total' AS tipo,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad
FROM messages
WHERE direction = 'incoming'
  AND deleted_at IS NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'INCOMING - Con campaign_id' AS tipo,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad
FROM messages
WHERE direction = 'incoming'
  AND campaign_id IS NOT NULL
  AND deleted_at IS NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'INCOMING - Sin campaign_id' AS tipo,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad
FROM messages
WHERE direction = 'incoming'
  AND campaign_id IS NULL
  AND deleted_at IS NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'OUTGOING manual - Total' AS tipo,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad
FROM messages
WHERE direction = 'outgoing'
  AND is_mass_campaign = FALSE
  AND deleted_at IS NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'OUTGOING manual - Con campaign_id' AS tipo,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad
FROM messages
WHERE direction = 'outgoing'
  AND is_mass_campaign = FALSE
  AND campaign_id IS NOT NULL
  AND deleted_at IS NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'OUTGOING manual - Sin campaign_id' AS tipo,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad
FROM messages
WHERE direction = 'outgoing'
  AND is_mass_campaign = FALSE
  AND campaign_id IS NULL
  AND deleted_at IS NULL;

-- ========================================================================
-- PASO 2: IDENTIFICAR mensajes que DEBERÍAN tener campaign_id
-- Encuentra mensajes (incoming y outgoing manual) sin campaign_id donde
-- existe un mensaje de campaña previo al mismo número
-- ========================================================================

SELECT
    msg.id AS message_id,
    msg.direction,
    msg.phone_number,
    msg.line_id,
    msg.created_at AS message_date,
    msg.campaign_id AS current_campaign_id,
    campaign_msg.campaign_id AS should_have_campaign_id,
    campaign_msg.campaign_name,
    campaign_msg.sent_at AS campaign_sent_date,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, campaign_msg.sent_at, msg.created_at) AS minutes_after_campaign
FROM messages msg
INNER JOIN (
    -- Encuentra el mensaje de campaña MÁS RECIENTE antes de cada mensaje
    SELECT
        m.phone_number,
        m.line_id,
        m.campaign_id,
        m.campaign_name,
        m.created_at AS sent_at,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY m.phone_number, m.line_id
            ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM messages m
    WHERE m.is_mass_campaign = TRUE
      AND m.direction = 'outgoing'
      AND m.campaign_id IS NOT NULL
      AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
) campaign_msg
    ON campaign_msg.phone_number = msg.phone_number
    AND campaign_msg.line_id = msg.line_id
    AND campaign_msg.rn = 1
    AND campaign_msg.sent_at < msg.created_at  -- Campaña enviada ANTES del mensaje
WHERE msg.campaign_id IS NULL  -- Sin campaign_id actualmente
  AND msg.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND (
      -- Mensajes incoming (respuestas de clientes)
      msg.direction = 'incoming'
      OR
      -- Mensajes outgoing manuales (respuestas de agentes)
      (msg.direction = 'outgoing' AND msg.is_mass_campaign = FALSE)
  )
ORDER BY msg.created_at DESC
LIMIT 50;

-- ========================================================================
-- PASO 3: CONTEO de mensajes a actualizar
-- ========================================================================

SELECT
    'INCOMING' AS tipo,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad
FROM messages msg
WHERE msg.direction = 'incoming'
  AND msg.campaign_id IS NULL
  AND msg.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM messages campaign_msg
      WHERE campaign_msg.phone_number = msg.phone_number
        AND campaign_msg.line_id = msg.line_id
        AND campaign_msg.is_mass_campaign = TRUE
        AND campaign_msg.direction = 'outgoing'
        AND campaign_msg.campaign_id IS NOT NULL
        AND campaign_msg.created_at < msg.created_at
        AND campaign_msg.deleted_at IS NULL
  )

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'OUTGOING manual' AS tipo,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad
FROM messages msg
WHERE msg.direction = 'outgoing'
  AND msg.is_mass_campaign = FALSE
  AND msg.campaign_id IS NULL
  AND msg.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM messages campaign_msg
      WHERE campaign_msg.phone_number = msg.phone_number
        AND campaign_msg.line_id = msg.line_id
        AND campaign_msg.is_mass_campaign = TRUE
        AND campaign_msg.direction = 'outgoing'
        AND campaign_msg.campaign_id IS NOT NULL
        AND campaign_msg.created_at < msg.created_at
        AND campaign_msg.deleted_at IS NULL
  );

-- ========================================================================
-- PASO 4: ACTUALIZACIÓN - Asignar campaign_id a respuestas
-- ADVERTENCIA: Esto modificará los datos
-- ========================================================================

-- Crear tabla temporal con los campaign_id correctos
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE temp_message_campaigns AS
SELECT
    incoming.id AS message_id,
    latest_campaign.campaign_id,
    latest_campaign.campaign_name,
    latest_campaign.assigned_user_id,
    latest_campaign.assigned_user_ids
FROM messages incoming
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
        m.phone_number,
        m.line_id,
        m.campaign_id,
        m.campaign_name,
        m.assigned_user_id,
        m.assigned_user_ids,
        m.created_at,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY m.phone_number, m.line_id
            ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM messages m
    WHERE m.is_mass_campaign = TRUE
      AND m.direction = 'outgoing'
      AND m.campaign_id IS NOT NULL
      AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
) latest_campaign
    ON latest_campaign.phone_number = incoming.phone_number
    AND latest_campaign.line_id = incoming.line_id
    AND latest_campaign.rn = 1
    AND latest_campaign.created_at < incoming.created_at
WHERE incoming.direction = 'incoming'
  AND incoming.campaign_id IS NULL
  AND incoming.deleted_at IS NULL;

-- Ver qué se va a actualizar
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_a_actualizar,
    COUNT(DISTINCT campaign_id) AS campanas_distintas,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBSTRING_INDEX(campaign_id, '-', 1)) AS tipos_campana
FROM temp_message_campaigns;

-- ACTUALIZAR los mensajes con el campaign_id correcto
UPDATE messages m
INNER JOIN temp_message_campaigns tmp ON tmp.message_id = m.id
SET
    m.campaign_id = tmp.campaign_id,
    m.campaign_name = tmp.campaign_name,
    -- También actualizar assigned_user_ids si están vacíos
    m.assigned_user_id = COALESCE(m.assigned_user_id, tmp.assigned_user_id),
    m.assigned_user_ids = COALESCE(m.assigned_user_ids, tmp.assigned_user_ids);

-- Limpiar tabla temporal
DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS temp_message_campaigns;

-- ========================================================================
-- PASO 5: VERIFICACIÓN POST-ACTUALIZACIÓN
-- ========================================================================

SELECT
    'Total mensajes incoming' AS tipo,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad
FROM messages
WHERE direction = 'incoming'
  AND deleted_at IS NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'Con campaign_id' AS tipo,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad
FROM messages
WHERE direction = 'incoming'
  AND campaign_id IS NOT NULL
  AND deleted_at IS NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'Sin campaign_id' AS tipo,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad
FROM messages
WHERE direction = 'incoming'
  AND campaign_id IS NULL
  AND deleted_at IS NULL;

-- ========================================================================
-- CONSULTAS ADICIONALES DE VERIFICACIÓN
-- ========================================================================

-- Ver distribución de respuestas por campaña
SELECT
    campaign_id,
    campaign_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_respuestas,
    COUNT(DISTINCT phone_number) AS clientes_unicos,
    MIN(created_at) AS primera_respuesta,
    MAX(created_at) AS ultima_respuesta
FROM messages
WHERE direction = 'incoming'
  AND campaign_id IS NOT NULL
  AND deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY campaign_id, campaign_name
ORDER BY total_respuestas DESC
LIMIT 20;

-- Ver conversaciones con respuestas actualizadas
SELECT
    m.phone_number,
    m.line_id,
    m.direction,
    m.campaign_id,
    m.campaign_name,
    m.message_content,
    m.created_at
FROM messages m
WHERE m.phone_number IN (
    -- Números que tienen tanto mensajes de campaña como respuestas
    SELECT DISTINCT phone_number
    FROM messages
    WHERE campaign_id IS NOT NULL
      AND direction = 'incoming'
    LIMIT 5
)
ORDER BY m.phone_number, m.created_at
LIMIT 50;

-- Verificar que las respuestas tienen el mismo campaign_id que el mensaje enviado
SELECT
    outgoing.phone_number,
    outgoing.campaign_id AS sent_campaign_id,
    incoming.campaign_id AS response_campaign_id,
    CASE
        WHEN outgoing.campaign_id = incoming.campaign_id THEN '✓ Correcto'
        ELSE '✗ Desincronizado'
    END AS status,
    outgoing.created_at AS sent_at,
    incoming.created_at AS response_at
FROM messages outgoing
INNER JOIN messages incoming
    ON incoming.phone_number = outgoing.phone_number
    AND incoming.line_id = outgoing.line_id
    AND incoming.direction = 'incoming'
    AND incoming.created_at > outgoing.created_at
WHERE outgoing.is_mass_campaign = TRUE
  AND outgoing.direction = 'outgoing'
  AND outgoing.campaign_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY outgoing.created_at DESC
LIMIT 30;

    SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'incoming' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS incoming,
    SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'outgoing' AND is_mass_campaign = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outgoing_manual,
